text:
amy: Heads-up — new hire Priya Kumar starts Tue remote. Two issues: BG still 'pending docs' and she uploaded a passport image that vendor says doesn't match. Also needs I-9 verification.

lee: Ugh. Did vendor say what mismatch was? name formatting or photo quality?

bg-vendor-bot: Vendor note: Document image flagged for low-quality scan and name 'Priya K.' vs onboarding record 'Priya Kumar'. Requested re-upload and gov ID selfie.

anika: Priya replied — she can re-upload tonight. But worried it may not clear before Tuesday morning. Can we arrange a remote authorized agent/notary? Options: vendor remote notary (paid) or 3rd-party authorized agent near her (she's in Oakland).

amy: Remote notary is fine if the company policy allows. What's cost & ETA?

notary-agent: Remote I-9 agent availability: Tue 09:30, 13:00, 15:30 PST. Cost estimate: $85 per visit for on-site agent, $35 for vendor remote verification. Need candidate consent form signed to proceed.

lee: If BG vendor accepts the re-upload by EOD then we can do standard process. If not, schedule vendor remote verify at 09:30 Tue. That gives time buffer. Amy can you confirm candidate consent?

amy: Messaging Priya now with consent form + re-upload checklist (clear passport photo, good lighting, full name exact as in offer).

anika: Also note payroll/team needs W-4 and direct deposit before day 1. Priya said she needed help with benefits enrollment link too. Can we include the benefits packet in the welcome crate so she has it physically?

courier-bot: Can do a welcome packet drop if we have address confirmed. Estimated courier cost $12. ETA delivery Tue by noon if shipped Mon COB.

amy: Address confirmed on file: 88 Grove St, Apt 3, Oakland, CA 94607. Please mark "SIGNATURE_OPTIONAL" so courier doesn't hold it if she's at work.

it-bot: For provisional laptop access, we can create an escorted-only profile with the following constraints: no merge to production repos, limited VPN, expires in 5 days. Requires manager approval (anika).

anika: Approved. Create temporary profile only if BG not cleared by Tue 8:30am. Also require security checklist sign-off.

bg-vendor-bot: Candidate re-upload received at 18:42 PST. Under review, estimated resolution within 6-12 hrs.

amy: Great. If vendor doesn't clear by 07:30 Tue, plan B = remote vendor verification at 09:30 then escorted laptop pickup at coworking space (Priya can pick up at FlowSpace Oakland). I'll hold a slot with notary-agent for 09:30 just in case.

notary-agent: Tentative hold placed 09:30 Tue. Please confirm 24 hrs prior or forfeit hold. Refundable if used within 48 hrs.

lee: I'll prepare the benefits packet print (paper enrollment form, summary of plans, flex pretax info) and send to courier. Also DM Priya a link to online benefits portal + payroll W-4 form to prefill.

amy: Thanks everyone. I'll update here when BG clears or if we need to flip to the notary. Priya — please re-upload ASAP and sign the consent form when you get my note.

(lee reacts :white_check_mark:)
